name: AXM Evidence Desk
actions: route supplied claims to evidence surfaces
build and verify a SHA-256-sealed evidence receipt
save or export a draft by explicit human action
preview and explicitly place a bounded packet in the Knowledge Canvas inbox
summary: Route supplied claims to fitting proof surfaces, preserve open questions, and create integrity-verifiable receipts without pretending receipt generation independently proves the world.
notes: Evidence Desk keeps declared and effective verdicts separate. PASS without evidence remains open, SHA-256 proves content integrity rather than truth, Knowledge Canvas inbox placement never claims receiver acceptance, and CANON remains a human decision.

validate.description: Validate supplied evidence fields without saving or exporting.

build.description: Build a SHA-256-sealed receipt and Action Report without changing Workshop state.

verify.description: Recompute and compare a v2 receipt's canonical SHA-256 content digest.

handoff-preview.description: Build a digest-bound Knowledge Canvas packet without writing its inbox.
